title: Track mail delivery
subtitle: Find a message recipient and inspect Postfix delivery attempts. Acceptance or queueing alone does not mean delivery.
handoff_hint: Sent means Postfix handed the message to the next server or local mailbox. It is not a read receipt. Forwarding is an intermediate step, not final delivery.
date_hint: Dates use UTC; the end date includes the whole day.
invalid_dates: The end date must not be before the start date.
list_failed: Could not load delivery history. Refresh to try again.
empty: No tracked recipients match these filters. Acceptance-only records do not prove delivery; check the collection status above.
detail_failed: Could not load the recipient timeline. Refresh the timeline to try again.
timeline_truncated: Only the most recent 1,000 events are shown. Earlier attempts are omitted.
no_events: No attempt events are available for this recipient.
forwarded_hint: Postfix forwarded this recipient to another queue. This result does not confirm final delivery.
source_starting: The delivery collector is starting. History may not be available yet.
source_unavailable: The delivery source is unavailable. Existing records are shown, but new attempts may be missing or out of date.
history_gap: There is a gap in the collected history. Some events may be missing; an absent record is not proof of non-delivery.
